Results.ReviewText: I love this small gas grill (two burners).  My previous grill (also a Weber) lasted 18 years, so the layout of the controls are different, and I really like them. Results.ReviewText: I bought this BBQ based on the opinion given by the salesman at the store. I told him I was interested in 3 different brands, Weber being one of them. After some discussion, I chose to go with the Weber. The reason? I was completely sold when the salesman stated Weber customer service was second to none - and I found out almost immediately that his statement was TRUE!! I opened the box to build my new BBQ and much to my surprise, the main leg assembly was bent beyond use. The box had no physical damage at all. I contacted the store where I purchased it and the same salesman suggested I contact Weber directly, as they would take care of any issues quicker than he could. So I did. Low and behold, I received my replacement part within 5 days and completed assembly shortly thereafter. So, suffice it to say, I made the right decision and could not be happier!!! Thanks Weber...
Results.Title: Amazing Customer Service!!

Results.ReviewText: Arrived with a dangerously flawed igniter that took a long time to light and lit with dangerously explosive effect once it finally worked. Customer service sent a new electrode and the grill now lights quickly. With a full tank of gas, reaches 600 degrees in 10 minutes, about 5 minutes longer when the tank is half-full or less. Wish Weber would make a Genesis version of this smaller grill with the small sear burner they added to those models this year. Happy with the grill otherwise, very economical propane consumption.
Results.Title: Problem out of box fixed under warranty.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
